perspective: 竖版俯视固定视角，玩家位于屏幕底部向上射击
core_gameplay: Original insect-wave shooter, mouse steering/hold fire, original boss capture/rescue and stage definitions retained; actual Stage1defeat, no victory claim.
core_experience: 经典街机快节奏射击：走位躲避、连续命中得分、营救双机强化火力、逐关挑战刷新最高分。
controls: Mouse steer/hold left fire; P/Escape pause, original resume button and mute.
game_loop: 开始：标题页点击开始 → 操作：移动射击清除编队敌机，躲避俯冲与敌弹 → 结果：清关进入下一关，每3关为奖励关；被击中失去生命，生命耗尽游戏结束 → 继续：重新开始挑战更高分。
content: 敌机含蜘蛛（boss）、蝴蝶、蜜蜂三类编队；关卡循环推进、每3关奖励关；具体总关卡数为程序循环生成，无固定上限（源码确认）。
progression: 阶段（STAGE）逐关递增显示于右上；分数与最高分实时显示；营救战机获得双机火力（双机被击损失一半）。
save: Original swarmHi localStorage highscore, actualHI2540 reload proved; no mid-run save.
rules: 目标：击落敌机得分并存活。计分：击落敌机得分（画面显示100等分值），奖励关按命中数结算；失败：被敌机或敌弹命中损失生命，生命归零游戏结束；被俘战机可被击坠蜘蛛救回（阈值细节未逐项确认）。
systems: 对象：玩家机、双机、子弹、敌弹、三类敌机、粒子、飘字、星空；状态：title/play/paused/over；交互：入场路径→编队摆动→俯冲攻击；俘获/营救系统；暂停菜单含SOUND与RESUME。
ui_flow: 标题页（操作说明+HI分）→点击开始→战斗HUD（SCORE/HI/STAGE/SOUND/PAUSE）→P或按钮→PAUSED页（RESUME恢复）→生命耗尽→结束页→回标题。
level_design: 固定编队槽位（顶行蜘蛛、中两行蝴蝶、底两行蜜蜂），敌人按侧向入场路径飞入就位；关数程序递增，难度递进方式未完整验证。
verification: Desktop1280x720 actual unchanged original StarWing main.js. Ordinary mouse steering and hold-to-fire, formation/dive/hit/score/life-loss feedback, actual Ppause/resume overlay. Intermediate run transitions not all captured, only explicit final Stage1 GAMEOVER2540 claimed. Original click restart score0/3reserve-life icons/HI2540, reload titleHI2540 restored. No stage-clear/victory claim. Original rules/difficulty/score/weapons/capture/rescue/boss/stages/local score preserved. Boss capture-rescue/dual-fighter, challenging/later stages, mobile touch and audio hearing not exhausted. Complete final window startup/shooting/pause/resume/GameOver/restart/reload27requests local, no truncation/missing/external/errors.
